observations.quote:
JESUS ROSE FROM THE DEAD · DAVID WOOD
"We have Christian, Jewish and Roman sources reporting Jesus execution"

Wood presents convergent reporting and ordinary Roman crucifixion practice as the historical foundation for inferring Jesus’s death before considering resurrection appearances.

"

RESURRECTION FROM DEATH IS NOT ESTABLISHED · SHABIR ALLY
"there are good reasons for thinking that Jesus did not actually die on the cross"

Ally opens by challenging whether the reported death is sufficiently established, while later conceding that critical scholars widely accept it.

"
